episodeTitle.en: A UGC masterclass from the 22-year-old who built Wispr Flow’s growth machine | Hector Serrano
episodeTitle.zh: 搭建 Wispr Flow 增长体系的 22 岁操盘手，讲透用户创作内容｜Hector Serrano

guestBioOfficial.zh: Hector Serrano 在 Wispr Flow 负责内容，从自己持续制作广告，做到组织一群创作者为语音输入产品制作内容。他熟悉从第一次邀约、合作说明，到最终审核一支视频的全过程。
guestBioOfficial.en: Hector heads content at Wispr Flow. He went from personally producing ads for its voice-to-text product to running a creator program, working across outreach, onboarding, and final review.

title.en: A UGC masterclass from the 22-year-old who built Wispr Flow’s growth machine | Hector Serrano
title.zh: 搭建 Wispr Flow 增长体系的 22 岁操盘手，讲透用户创作内容｜Hector Serrano

summary.zh: 从一个人每周做广告，到五十人的合作网络，哪些工作值得标准化？Hector 拆开邀约、筛选和交付流程，也解释为什么有些环节即使能自动化，品牌仍要留一个人把关。
summary.en: Hector describes taking creator advertising from a one-person operation to a fifty-person program. He walks through selection and outreach, then explains where human review still matters to the brand.

insights.title: 先自己做够多，才知道要教什么
insights.detail: Hector 有一年半亲自做每周的广告，做过数百支。后来跟创作者沟通时，他已经知道从想法到成片要经过哪些具体工作。
insights.detailEn: Making hundreds of ads over a year and a half gave Hector firsthand knowledge of the work he later asked creators to do.

insights.title: 给推荐新人设一道质量门槛
insights.detail: 团队规模上限约五十人。只有推荐来的人确实适合、获邀加入，推荐才有意义，这让成员有动力介绍合适的人。
insights.detailEn: The roster is capped at about fifty. Referrals matter when the person fits the program, which keeps the incentive tied to quality.

insights.title: 第一封邀请只争取下一次交流
insights.detail: Hector 先说自己喜欢对方的内容，问有没有兴趣。等对方回应，再发合作方式、分成和案例，最后才签约、进群和开通产品。
insights.detailEn: Start with a specific invitation. Send the brief, payment details, and examples after the creator expresses interest.
insights.titleEn: Earn a reply before sending the brief

related.reason: 对照 Duolingo 的增长实践，看内容实验怎样积累成可重复的方法。
related.reasonEn: Compare how repeated growth experiments turned into a practice at Duolingo.

title.zh: 扩展Duolingo、拥抱失败及对拉丁美洲科技领域的洞察 | 吉娜·戈特利夫（Latitud，Duolingo）
